title: Outcome Graph shared definitions
description: Shared primitives for all outcome-graph artifacts. Patterns mirror ixo-evals-engine artefacts/common.defs.v1.json so artifacts cross the boundary without translation. Conventions: snake_case field names (archival layer), integer basis points 0..10000 for every score (floats break byte-determinism and replay digests), content-addressed URNs over canonical JSON (sorted keys at every level).

content_addressed_uri.description: Self-certifying artifact id: urn:ixo:<type>:<multibase-multihash> of the canonicalized artifact bytes.

bps.description: Basis points. 0 = 0%, 10000 = 100%. Never use floats for scores.

time_interval.description: Half-open interval [start, end). Omit end for open-ended scopes.

versioned_ref.description: Hash-pinned reference to a versioned artifact (rubric, schema, policy).

source_span.description: Provenance pointer into a source artifact. locator uses the evals-engine locator styles (json_pointer, xpath, csv_cell, time_window, page/line, bounding box).

provenance.description: How this element came to exist. ai_inferred elements MUST carry rationale; nothing enters the graph without either a source span or a declared inference.

extractor_ref.description: Agent/skill/model that produced the element, e.g. 'outcome-graph/toc-intake@0.1.0'.

asserted_proposition.description: Subject-predicate-object triple — the graph-native claim substrate, internal to the pipeline. (The live engine boundary carries canonicalized answers-bag claim bodies instead; S-P-O never crosses it.)

validation_status.description: Epistemic status of a causal edge. See references/causal-checks.md for the promotion/demotion rules and the mapping from evals-engine verdicts.

engine_verdict_class.description: evals-engine VerdictClass (live main@6dae503, src/lib/rubric/eval/decide.ts) — the semantic discriminant of an evaluation. Layered under the 4-value Verdict (approve|partial|reject|review) and above the chain status.

engine_verdict.description: evals-engine Verdict (coarse, 4 values). Branch on engine_verdict_class for semantics; this is the disposition.

engine_chain_status.description: x/claims EvaluationStatus as the live engine writes it: 1 approve, 2 reject, 5 review/flag. (The chain enum defines 0-5; the engine constructs only these three. Code 2 aggregates refuted/invalid_evidence/out_of_authority — always branch on engine_verdict_class, never on this alone.)

tier.description: Impact-claim tier: 1 narrative plausibility, 2 evidence-backed contribution, 3 causally supported outcome, 4 issuance-ready certified outcome. 0 = no tier attainable.
